verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an immigration-services platform, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never shows an assistant users can delegate tasks to. The only AI mention is a vague claim of 'AI workflows' paired with attorneys, and the guided intake flow and eligibility checker are questionnaires, not an assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
